title: Corvina Q4 sales status
brief: Corvina Software's sales operations wants a weekly status page for fiscal Q4 (which began on 2026-08-31, week 36), as of week 42 ending 2026-10-16, for the CRO's Monday meeting. Bookings to date are 6.9 million dollars against a Q4 target of 11.5 million (60 percent), open pipeline is 14.8 million, win rate is 27 percent and the average deal is 84000 dollars. Weekly bookings in millions: W36 0.5, W37 0.7, W38 0.6, W39 1.1, W40 0.9, W41 1.4, W42 1.7. Under "Regions", compare target, booked and percent of target, in millions: North America, 5.2, 3.4, 65; EMEA, 4.1, 2.3, 56; APAC, 2.2, 1.2, 55. APAC and EMEA are behind and must be easy to spot. Under "Deals to watch", three: Hollis Rail, 1.2 million, EMEA, close date 2026-10-30, Ravi Menon; Pacific Grid, 900000 dollars, APAC, close date 2026-11-13, Aiko Fujimoto; Northline Clinics, 750000 dollars, North America, close date 2026-10-23, Dana Whitfield. Under "Next week": the forecast call on 2026-10-19 and the APAC pipeline review on 2026-10-21. People will read this on their phones.

edit.request: Add W43 at 1.3 million, update bookings to date to 8.2 million (71 percent of target), and mark Northline Clinics as won.
